description: This file defines the 'Interpreter' system used in functorch for managing different transformation interpreters (Vmap, Grad, Jvp, Functionalize). It includes enum definitions, metadata structures, the main Interpreter class with serialization, and utility functions related to the interpreter stack.

classes.name: VmapInterpreterMeta
classes.description: Holds metadata for Vmap interpreters, including batch size and randomness type.

classes.name: GradInterpreterMeta
classes.description: Holds metadata for Grad interpreters, including previous gradient mode.

classes.name: JvpInterpreterMeta
classes.description: Holds metadata for Jvp interpreters, including previous forward gradient mode.

classes.name: FunctionalizeInterpreterMeta
classes.description: Holds metadata for Functionalize interpreters, including whether to add back views.

classes.name: Interpreter
classes.description: Main struct representing an interpreter with type, level, metadata, and associated methods for processing and serialization.

methods.name: Vmap
methods.description: Factory method to create a Vmap interpreter with specified level, batch size, and randomness.

methods.name: Grad
methods.description: Factory method to create a Grad interpreter with specified level and previous gradient mode.

methods.name: Jvp
methods.description: Factory method to create a Jvp interpreter with specified level and previous forward gradient mode.

methods.name: Functionalize
methods.description: Factory method to create a Functionalize interpreter with specified level and back views flag.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Executes the operator with the interpreter's semantics on the given stack.

methods.name: sendToNextInterpreter
methods.description: Sends the operator to the next interpreter in the stack.

methods.name: saveLocalDispatchKeySet
methods.description: Saves the current local dispatch key set.

methods.name: clearSavedLocalDispatchKeySet
methods.description: Clears the saved local dispatch key set.

methods.name: getSavedLocalDispatchKeySet
methods.description: Retrieves the saved local dispatch key set.

methods.name: is_alive
methods.description: Checks if the interpreter is currently active.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the interpreter to a JSON string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string to an Interpreter object.
